steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: This page scans about a hundred well-known stocks. It ranks them by closeness to a key price level. Every ranked row now also says how many days old that price reading is. Hovering over any row shows the exact date and time behind it.
steps.point_out: A new "basis" column sits at the end of the table, showing a real date and day-count for every row. Some rows are only a few days old; others are two weeks old or more.

steps.title: Look at a scan from before this update
steps.narration: Opening a scan recorded before this feature existed shows an honest note instead of a guess. The page says plainly that this measurement wasn't captured back then.
steps.point_out: Every row's "basis" cell reads "basis not recorded in this snapshot." It is never a blank cell or a made-up date.

expect.text: basis not recorded in this snapshot

steps.title: Confirm a row still opens its chart
steps.narration: A new column was added to this row. Clicking anywhere on it — even the new "basis" text — still opens that stock's own chart.
steps.point_out: The page jumps straight to the Structure chart for AAPL. Its key price levels are already loaded.

steps.title: Move to the live tape reader
steps.narration: The Desk sits alongside two earlier pages, both reachable from the same menu at the top.
steps.point_out: The Cockpit page opens, ready to watch a stock's price action.

steps.title: Name a practice stock
steps.narration: Typing in a practice ticker that always settles into a predictable pattern, so you can try the reader without needing a real market feed.
steps.point_out: The ticker field now reads SIM-BUYER.

steps.title: Watch the tape settle
steps.narration: After watching for a moment, the reading settles into a clear call.
steps.point_out: The Tape State panel shows the bold read-out "Buyer Control", with live price bars, trades, and an event log all filled in.

steps.title: Switch to a real recorded stock
steps.narration: Switching to Historical mode replays a real stock's own recorded price action instead of a live practice feed.
steps.point_out: The Historical option is now selected.

steps.title: Name the real stock
steps.narration: Typing in a real stock symbol to replay its recorded price history.
steps.point_out: The symbol field now reads AAPL.

steps.title: Choose the day to replay
steps.narration: Typing in the day to replay.

steps.title: Fill the trading day in one click
steps.narration: One click fills in the whole trading day, instead of typing exact times by hand.
steps.point_out: The start and end time fields fill in automatically.

steps.title: Start the replay
steps.narration: Watching starts the replay of that real stock's real trading day.
steps.point_out: The page now shows it is watching AAPL.

steps.title: See the real chart with its key levels drawn on
steps.narration: Switching the chart to hourly bars shows the stock's real recorded price history, with its key support and resistance levels drawn right on top.
steps.point_out: Real candles, the timeframe switch, and the price-level lines are all drawn on the same chart.

expect.text: Recorded 1h bars sit left of the start marker; bars to its right are built live from the tape.
